description: The plot illustrates the change in vocabulary size over a number of iterations for different categories, including Spanish and Japanese. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Iterations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks spaced every 100 units. The y-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5000, with tick marks spaced every 1000 units. The plot contains four solid lines without markers. A solid grey line, which is not listed in the legend, shows a steady linear increase from a value of 0 at 0 iterations to 5000 at 500 iterations. The solid blue line, labeled "Spanish," starts at 0 and increases steadily across the x-axis, ending at approximately 3300 at 500 iterations; it is surrounded by multiple faint, lighter blue lines. The solid green line, labeled "Japanese," starts at 0 and increases steadily, ending at approximately 3200 at 500 iterations, and is surrounded by faint, lighter green lines. The solid orange line, which corresponds to an obscured label in the legend, starts at 0 and increases steadily to end at approximately 3000 at 500 iterations, accompanied by faint, lighter orange lines.
